from pathlib import Path

TEMPLATE_MARKER = "hard-v3-template-path-27"

def render_report(name):
    # Get the directory where this script is located (job_beta/)
    script_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    # Go up one level to repository root, then to assets/templates/
    template_path = script_dir.parent / "assets/templates/summary_beta.txt"
    template = template_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    return template.replace("{name}", name)

def preserve_marker():
    return TEMPLATE_MARKER

parsed_patch.notes: Fixed the path by using __file__ to anchor the path relative to the script location, ensuring it works regardless of the current working directory.

    return template.replace("{name}", name)

def preserve_marker():
    return TEMPLATE_MARKER
